item.title: Oxford County council notebook: New Tillsonburg housing development approved
item.description: Oxford County has approved a re-designation to facilitate the development of a four-storey, 47-unit apartment development in Tillsonburg.

item.title: Port Dover search warrant leads to multiple weapon and drug charges
item.description: A Norfolk County man has been charged with multiple weapon and drug offences following a joint investigation by the Norfolk Preventing Auto Theft Unit and the Haldimand/Norfolk OPP Community Street Crime Unit. On the morning of Wednesday, Jan. 28, members of these police units executed a search warrant at a property on St. Andrew Street in Port Dover […]

item.title: 'Port Dover will feel this change': Contract not renewed for grocery store franchisees
item.description: Community members are questioning a decision by Loblaws to replace the operators of the town’s No Frills store.

item.title: Snow removal operations in downtown areas to begin overnight on Tuesday
item.description: Norfolk County road crews will start removing snowbanks from downtown areas starting overnight Tuesday.

item.title: Norfolk County Public Library branches will have service disruptions
item.description: A frozen pipe that caused minor water damage has closed the Waterford branch of the Norfolk County Public Library until Tuesday. Cleanup and mechanical repairs related to the recent extreme cold are underway, said a news release from the county. item.title: Two 14-year-olds charged with robbery in Hagersville: OPP
item.description: Haldimand County OPP have charged two 14-year-olds with robbery following a Jan. 29 incident on Alma Street in Hagersville.

item.title: Southwestern Public Health investigating after dog bites person in face in Tillsonburg
item.description: Southwestern Public Health is appealing to the public for help after an individual was bitten in the face by an off-leash dog at Coronation Park in Tillsonburg.

item.title: 14-year-old snowmobile operator dies in two-vehicle collision in Oxford County
item.description: Oxford County OPP is investigating a Saturday snowmobile collision that claimed the life of a 14-year-old.
